home.future_protocols: REST, GraphQL and SSE are queued next.
home.lede: A focused browser console for exercising disposable transport fixtures. Connect two clients, send a message, and watch the broadcast travel.
home.title: See every connection
home.protocols_lede: Choose a transport to inspect its contract.
protocol.graphql.name: GraphQL
protocol.rest.name: REST
protocol.sse.name: Server-Sent Events
websocket.chat_empty: Send a message to see local send and receive timing.
websocket.chat_note: Times are measured in this browser. The server does not provide sender IDs or network timestamps; every broadcast is shown as received.
websocket.connected_hint: Messages are sent as { message } and broadcast to every client.
websocket.disconnected_hint: Connect before sending a JSON message.
websocket.error_hint: Check the event log and connect again.
websocket.lede: Use two independent connections to verify echo, broadcast and close behavior. Both clients share the current page origin.
websocket.title: WebSocket
lab.run_to_see: Run a scenario to see the response.
rest.title: REST
rest.lede: Run deterministic request presets and inspect the HTTP contract without changing the fixture.
rest.description: Each scenario calls one existing endpoint and renders its method, payload, status and response.
rest.hint: Choose a scenario, review the request, then send it to the same origin.
rest.ready: Request selected. Review it and select Send request.
rest.run_to_see: Send the selected request to see the response.
rest.network_failed: The request could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
graphql.title: GraphQL
graphql.lede: Compare query shapes, variables and validation errors against the deterministic schema.
graphql.description: Presets cover a basic query, variables and a schema error while preserving the existing endpoint contract.
graphql.hint: Choose a query to send it as a POST request.
graphql.completed: Query completed; inspect data or errors.
graphql.failed: Query request returned an error response.
sse.title: Server-Sent Events
sse.lede: Open a bounded browser stream and inspect event IDs, event names and JSON data as they arrive.
sse.description: Connections are explicit: connect, observe status events, disconnect, then reconnect when you choose.
sse.connected_hint: Receiving status events from the same origin.
sse.disconnected_hint: Connect to open the event stream.
sse.error_hint: The stream stopped. Connect again to retry explicitly.
